The sun is yet to rise in Bangladesh and the dreams of a cricketing nation are still taking shape, drifting away slowly but surely from Darwin to Mackay. Lying on the east coast of Queensland, the venue is set to host its first-ever Test, thereby becoming the 12th Test venue in Australia. And like any proud Australian host, they've talked about dishing out a pitch with good pace and bounce. Not that it's going to scare Bangladesh away. Riding the high of their greatest-ever win, they'll be taking anything on at this point, and the self-belief will be through the roof.
